evaluation.overall_comment:
The translation successfully captures all technical content and dialogue structure from the original English podcast script, with no information lost. However, its quality is significantly undermined by critical structural flaws (notably a raw JSON object embedded mid-text) and persistent fluency issues. With thorough editing to fix structural integrity, improve conversational flow, and localize terminology appropriately, it could reach professional podcast standards.
